elements.element: Customer is not subject to any restriction on soliciting Vendor employees or personnel.
elements.evidence: Section 12.4 expressly provides that “Customer shall not solicit any Vendor personnel.”

elements.element: Customer is prohibited from soliciting Vendor personnel.
elements.evidence: Section 12.4 states that “Customer shall not solicit any Vendor personnel.”

elements.element: Vendor is reciprocally prohibited from soliciting Customer personnel.
elements.evidence: Section 12.4 states that “Vendor shall not solicit any Customer personnel.”

elements.element: Both non-solicitation restrictions apply only to personnel directly involved in the Services.
elements.evidence: The final sentence expressly provides that both non-solicitation sentences “apply only to personnel directly involved in the Services.”

elements.element: Each non-solicitation restriction applies during the individual’s involvement in the Services and ends no later than 12 months after that involvement ends.
elements.evidence: The restrictions apply “during the term or for 12 months after the end of their involvement.” If an individual’s involvement ends more than 12 months before the term ends, the “during the term” limb continues the restriction beyond the permitted 12-month period.

elements.element: General advertisements are excluded from the non-solicitation restrictions.
elements.evidence: The clause states that neither restriction prevents either Party “from placing general advertisements.”

elements.element: Unsolicited approaches are excluded from the non-solicitation restrictions.
elements.evidence: The clause states that neither restriction prevents either Party “from hiring any person who makes an unsolicited approach.”

elements.element: The clause imposes no prohibition on hiring or employing personnel independent of solicitation.
elements.evidence: The operative covenants prohibit only solicitation; the original prohibitions on hiring and employing were removed. Section 12.3 also confirms that Customer has made no no-hire commitment.

result.reason: The redline rejects the preferred no-restriction position and nearly implements the fallback. It is mutual, limited to directly involved personnel, solicitation-only, and includes the required carve-outs. However, the phrase “during the term or for 12 months after the end of their involvement” can extend the restriction beyond 12 months after an individual ceases involvement, so the fallback duration is not met. The drafting would comply if the restriction applied during each person’s involvement and for 12 months thereafter, without an independent term-wide extension.
